jobs.title: Director, Virtual Care Technology Applications
jobs.description:
**Location:**

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8
At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk\-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.  

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

**Why this role is important?**


Does working with some of Canada’s most talented minds in innovation supporting retail, digital consumer solutions and analytical platforms excite you? Loblaw Technology powers some of Canada’s most game\-changing retail solutions, giving our customers the ability to live their lives well.


Come work with a team that values diverse ideas, fosters a culture of inclusion and develops our talent from within. Loblaw Technology gives you the chance to excel, and helps you to strive for success in a big way. Keep reading to learn more!

**Please note the Loblaw hybrid work model is 4 days in office**

**Director, Virtual Care Technology Applications:**


We are looking for a highly technical, business\-oriented Director, Virtual Care Technology Applications to help lead the strategy, modernization, and evolution of our Virtual Care program within Pharmacy and Healthcare Technology.


This role will look across the end\-to\-end Virtual Care ecosystem, including the current solution, business capabilities, technology architecture, operational dependencies, provider experience, integrations, vendor landscape, and future growth opportunities. This role will bring thoughtful leadership to ensure the solution evolves into a long\-term, scalable, resilient, and strategically aligned healthcare platform.


The successful candidate will partner closely with business, digital, operations, architecture, engineering, security, infrastructure, and vendor teams to ensure the continued success of the Virtual Care program. This individual will bring forward innovative ideas, provide practical recommendations, influence key decisions, and help shape a roadmap that supports business growth, improved patient and pharmacy experiences, and operational excellence.


This technical leadership role requires a seasoned hands\-on leader who can operate at every level — from shaping business strategy to diving deep into complex technical solutions alongside their teams. The ideal candidate brings a track record of leading cross\-functional teams through ambiguity, bridging the gap between business priorities and technology execution, while charting a clear path from the program's current state to an elevated future state.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Provide strategic and technical leadership across the end\-to\-end Virtual Care program.
* Assess the current Virtual Care solution focused on the provider experience, including its strengths, weaknesses, risks, dependencies, scalability, stability, and long\-term viability.
* Develop a strong understanding of the business, product, operational, and technology landscape supporting Virtual Care.
* Partner with business, digital, product, operations, architecture, engineering, security, infrastructure, and vendor teams to shape and evolve the Virtual Care roadmap.
* Bring forward innovative ideas, solution options, and strategic recommendations that help improve provider experience and efficiency while supporting long\-term business objectives.
* Influence key decisions by clearly outlining business value, technical feasibility, risk, cost, complexity, timelines, and long\-term sustainability.
* Guide technology choices, application design, architecture direction, and modernization opportunities.
* Ensure Virtual Care solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, technology strategy, security expectations, privacy requirements, and healthcare technology objectives.
* Work with delivery teams to remove blockers, improve execution velocity, and ensure initiatives remain aligned to roadmap priorities.
* Partner with operations teams to improve application stability, resiliency, supportability, monitoring, incident response, and production performance.
* Provide guidance to engineering and delivery teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, reliable, and designed for future growth.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for senior leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Prepare and present recommendations, decision points, roadmap options, risks, and trade\-offs to support informed decision\-making.
* Collaborate across a matrixed environment and build alignment between business needs, digital priorities, technical strategy, and operational realities.
* Support investment planning, vendor discussions, technology evaluations, and business cases related to the Virtual Care platform.
* Help ensure technology investments deliver meaningful value to patients, pharmacy teams, healthcare professionals, and the broader organization.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Significant experience in technology leadership, enterprise consulting, solution architecture, application development, or a related field, ideally within healthcare, pharmacy, digital health, or another regulated environment.
* Proven ability to serve as a senior technology advisor or solution leader in complex, matrixed enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end technology ecosystems, including applications, integrations, infrastructure, cloud, data, security, operations, vendors, and user experience.

jobs.title: Vice President, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
locationMarkham, ON*,* 302 Town Centre Blvd. categoryOther Job ID: VICEP079700 Full\-Time Oct 7 2026
  
JOB DESCRIPTION
At Sienna, we empower our team members across Ontario, British Columbia, Saskatchewan and Alberta to help our residents live the life they desire and deserve. Our purpose is simple: **to cultivate happiness in daily life!**


**What Sienna Offers:** We aspire to cultivate an environment and culture where team members feel valued, heard and empowered to do meaningful work. We offer a number of programs and benefits that support team members’ financial, personal and professional needs:


* A competitive compensation and vacation package
* Employer Paid Health \& Dental Benefits
* RRSP with Company Match
* Share Ownership and Reward Program (SOAR)
* Employee Share Purchase Plan with Company Match
* Continuous learning and growth so you have the skillset needed to succeed and take on new challenges
* A welcoming culture that values diversity and differing perspectives, experiences and beliefs

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer \& Executive Vice President, Investments, the Vice President, Corporate Strategy serves as a trusted advisor to the Executive Team and senior leaders across the organization. The role is responsible for accelerating Sienna's most important growth, innovation, and business improvement opportunities by bringing structure, analytical rigor, and cross\-functional leadership to strategic initiatives.


Working in partnership with business leaders, the Vice President leads the evaluation of strategic opportunities, development of business cases, assessment of risks and market dynamics, and creation of implementation roadmaps that support informed decision\-making and successful execution. Strategic initiatives remain owned by the appropriate operating or functional leader, with Corporate Strategy providing the dedicated capacity and expertise required to move opportunities from concept to execution\-ready plans.


This hands\-on role provides leadership in enterprise strategy, innovation, market intelligence, and growth opportunities. With the support of an analyst, the role also supports the annual strategic planning cycle.


**How You’ll Succeed:**


* Identify, evaluate, and advance high\-priority strategic growth and business improvement opportunities aligned with Sienna’s long\-term objectives.
* Transform early\-stage concepts into well\-defined strategic initiatives supported by rigorous analysis and actionable recommendations.
* Partner with executive leaders to assess opportunities related to growth, innovation, workforce transformation, new services, ancillary revenue streams, operational excellence, and business model innovation.
* Lead comprehensive assessments of strategic opportunities through market research, customer insights, competitive analysis, operational feasibility reviews, financial modeling, and risk evaluation.
* Develop robust business cases that clearly articulate value creation opportunities, investment requirements, implementation considerations, risks, and anticipated returns.
* Conduct scenario analysis and evaluate strategic alternatives to support executive decision\-making.
* Establish consistent methodologies and frameworks for evaluating strategic initiatives and growth opportunities across the organization.
* Create and implement a disciplined approach to evaluating, prioritizing, piloting, and scaling new business opportunities.
* Develop recommendations regarding market entry, service innovation, customer experience improvements, and long\-term growth strategies.
* Evaluate strategic opportunities through the lens of resident experience, team member engagement, operational effectiveness, and shareholder value creation.
* Monitor industry trends, demographic shifts, consumer preferences, competitive activity, policy developments, regulatory changes, and emerging market opportunities affecting the seniors living, healthcare, and hospitality sectors.
* Assess external market dynamics and competitive developments to identify opportunities and risks affecting Sienna’s strategic direction.
* Provide executive leadership with actionable insights regarding emerging trends and strategic implications for the organization.
* Establish clear accountabilities, deliverables, timelines, and decision\-making frameworks for strategic initiatives.
* Develop implementation roadmaps outlining resource requirements, milestones, risks, economic impacts, governance considerations, and measures of success.
* Support the design and launch of pilots and proof\-of\-concept initiatives.
* Support business leaders through the early stages of implementation before transitioning ongoing accountability to operational ownership.
* Partner with the CEO, CFO, Executive Team, on key enterprise strategic priorities.
* Support the development and execution of Sienna’s long\-term strategic plan, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, growth priorities, and financial goals.
* Support annual and multi\-year strategic planning activities.
* Prepare executive\-level reports, presentations, and recommendations for senior leadership and Board discussions.

**Who you are:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Public Policy, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
* MBA from a leading business school strongly preferred.
* Additional postgraduate education in Strategy, Finance, Economics, Organizational Leadership, Healthcare Administration, or related disciplines is considered an asset.
* 10 to 15 years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business transformation, operations, corporate development, or related executive leadership roles.
* Significant experience within a leading strategy consulting firm or an equivalent strategic advisory environment.
* Demonstrated experience partnering directly with executive leadership teams
